name: io.github.bestofgolang/bestofgo
title: Best of Go
description: Search and rank about 35,000 Go repos on GitHub by stars, recent star gains, and topics.

tools.name: category_repos
tools.description: The repos of one category, ranked by total stars or by stars gained in the last 30 days, with archived repos last. Each repo has its stars gained in the last 30 days, last push, and how many modules import it (pkg.go.dev), so candidates compare in one call. Repos awesome-go lists come first; classified marks repos a classifier added.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, such as web-frameworks or orm.

sort.description: stars (default) ranks by total stars; trending ranks by stars gained in the last 30 days.

limit.description: How many repos to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: One repo: total stars, rank among all tracked Go repos, stars gained in the last 7 days, 30 days, and 12 months, topics, archived state, last push, and how many modules import it (from pkg.go.dev).

repo.description: The repo as owner/name, such as pressly/goose.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories of Go repos: the libraries categories of awesome-go, such as web-frameworks, orm, and logging, and app categories such as ai-agents, mcp-servers, and kubernetes-and-containers, with repo counts and stars gained in the last 30 days.

contains.description: Only categories whose name, description, subcategories, or common topics contain this text, such as sql or k8s.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: GitHub topics, tags repo authors set, that at least 10 tracked Go repos carry, most repos first. Categories (list_categories) are the curated groups; topics narrow them down.

contains.description: Only topics whose name contains this text, such as sql.

limit.description: How many topics to return, 1 to 500. Default 50.

tools.name: owner_repos
tools.description: Every tracked Go repo of one GitHub user or organization, most stars first, with their totals.

owner.description: A GitHub user or organization, such as spf13.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search Go repositories by words, best match first. Popular repos rank higher among equal matches.

query.description: Words to search for, such as orm or http router. Every word must match the repo name, owner, topics, or description.

limit.description: How many repos to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

tools.name: star_history
tools.description: The stars one repo gained in each week, month, or year since it was created, oldest first.

repo.description: The repo as owner/name, such as pressly/goose.

bucket.description: One of week, month, or year. Default month.

tools.name: topic_repos
tools.description: The Go repos with one GitHub topic, a tag repo authors set, ranked by stars gained in the last 30 days and by total stars, with related topics. For curated groups, use category_repos.

topic.description: A GitHub topic, such as cli, orm, or web-framework. Use list_topics to find one.

limit.description: How many repos to return in each list, 1 to 50. Default 10.

tools.name: trending_repos
tools.description: The 10 Go repos that gained the most stars yesterday, in the last 7 days, or in the last 30 days, or the 10 with the most stars of all time.

range.description: One of yesterday, 7d, 30d, or all. Default 7d. all ranks by total stars.
